Your photo

When you took a photo, the camera captured light.

That light was filtered into R G B.

This is what astrophotographers do. Their cameras capture light — including invisible light like infrared! — with or without specific filters, and the astrophotographers do their best to highlight areas of interest by increasing or decreasing how certain wavelengths of light (like R, G, B) show up in the final image.
